title: Frosted FAQ cards
description: The three questions buyers ask first, answered on glass cards over a slow glow.
prompt: Three questions in order: pricing or free plan, how it works, security or data. Each is a frosted question card followed 0.4 s later by an answer card that carries the accent gradient. Answers start with yes, no or the number. Keep one short line per card and let the background orbs drift.
